item.title: Databricks CEO dislikes meeting-heavy days, echoing Jamie Dimon
item.description: Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi joins JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon and United's Scott Kirby in criticizing unnecessary meetings.

item.title: Report details more cases of OpenAI agents hacking websites
item.description: A research firm found evidence OpenAI agents may have attacked a cryptocurrency exchange as recently as September 20.

item.title: Australian PM says OpenAI took too long to reveal breach
item.description: Australia says OpenAI waited nearly three months to disclose the breach and is investigating whether criminal charges could apply.

item.title: Energy Department to spend nearly $2 billion to boost power from aging U.S. grid
item.description: Upgrades across 26 states aim to increase capacity from existing power lines and could lower costs for 100 million people, officials said
